title: bench_core.run_commit compares only _tools and .claude, so a branch that changes kb articles records the merge-base commit whose kb is not what the scenarios measured
goal: bench_core.run_commit records HEAD, with the stderr note, when the kb tree of HEAD differs from the merge-base's as well as when _tools or .claude differ, since the lookup, pool and retrieval scenarios measure the clone's kb

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
    clone = os.path.join(t, "clone"); bindir = os.path.join(t, "bin"); os.mkdir(bindir)
    open(os.path.join(bindir, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho 0.0.0\n"); os.chmod(os.path.join(bindir, "claude"), 0o755)
    env = dict(os.environ, PATH=bindir + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
    def git(*a):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@example.com", *a], cwd=clone, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", "--local", ".", clone], check=True)
    git("update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", "HEAD")
    git("switch", "-q", "-c", "work/ST-x")
    open(os.path.join(clone, "kb", "zz_probe.txt"), "w").write("x")
    git("add", "kb/zz_probe.txt")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "worker commit that changes kb")
    code = "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, \x27_tools\x27); import bench_core; print(bench_core.Bench(sys.argv[1], 1).commit)"
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, os.path.join(t, "scratch")], cwd=clone, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=120)
    head = git("rev-parse", "--short=7", "HEAD")
    out = p.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if p.stdout.strip() else ""
    print(p.returncode, out, head)
    sys.exit(0 if p.returncode == 0 and out == head else 1)
